The system still has significant limitations. The article Anthropic's new prototype proves which model wrote an AI response without exposing its weights appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Exit polls show AI ranked last among voter priorities in the 2026 U.S. midterms
items.excerpt: In the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, AI ranked last among campaign issues: only 56 percent of respondents cited AI and data centers as an important factor. According to NBC exit polls, corruption (90 percent) and the cost of living (89 percent) clearly dominated, despite growing public attention to the issue. The article Exit polls show AI ranked last among voter priorities in the 2026 U.S. midterm

items.title: Schools that turn off Google's AI will lose search too starting in 2027
items.excerpt: Starting in 2027, Google plans to turn off AI features in its school products by default, letting schools decide what to enable. The catch: schools that block AI entirely on their devices will also lose access to Google Search, since the two systems are now too deeply intertwined to separate. Given Google's grip on the US school market, that "choice" doesn't leave schools with much room to maneuve

items.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week
items.excerpt: OpenAI's hardware team used GPT-6 Astra to design a device for the Codex coding agent in under a week, handling everything from the enclosure to the circuit board to the firmware. Several revision rounds were needed before production because the model didn't always account for manufacturing tolerances. items.title: Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
items.excerpt: Stanford researchers tested 50 widely cited claims about LLMs against 20 current models. 44 percent of the findings are already "expired," and another 34 percent have weakened significantly. The average lifespan is just 15.7 months. Claims about what models can't do expire fastest. items.title: See the agents, set the terms: new visibility and control for personal agents
items.excerpt: Personal AI agents have changed how users interact with the web, blurring the lines between automated and human traffic. Learn how Cloudflare gives site owners visibility and control to manage personal agent access.

items.title: Introducing Zero Wire, a hub for investigating critical Internet vulnerabilities
items.excerpt: Zero Wire on Cloudflare Radar pairs plain-language briefings with global attack telemetry and remediation steps. Triage critical CVEs faster and decide how to protect your infrastructure.

items.title: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%
items.excerpt: Zone setting changes used to rebuild entire DNS zones, even ones with tens of millions of records. Here is how we built a planner that picks the smallest safe build, cutting full builds by 40%, peak memory by 85%, and halving build delay.
